name: forgot-only-once
why: turns-on-every-time: the repeated cold checks are never tried.

name: forgot-heater-already-off
why: switches-off-when-already-off: a warm room with the heater off is never tried.

name: forgot-the-edge
why: edge-of-the-band-switches: the boundary of the dead band is never tried.

name: forgot-nan
why: not-a-number-is-trusted: NaN is never returned by the mock sensor.

name: forgot-the-throwing-sensor
why: failure-keeps-the-heater-on / failure-is-reported-as-success: the sensor never throws.

name: no-strict-mock
why: plain mocks instead of StrictMock (Clean tier asks for StrictMock or NiceMock, and the unexpected turn_off goes unnoticed).

name: a-test-that-fails-on-good-code
why: a wrong expectation: the tests must pass on the real thermostat first.

name: an-expected-call-that-never-happens
why: EXPECT_CALL without a matching call is a failure when the mock is destroyed: the tests must pass on the real thermostat.

edits.old: reading_is(25.0);  // no EXPECT_CALL on the heater: the StrictMock fails the test if the thermostat touches it

name: a-warning-in-the-tests
why: an unused variable is a compiler warning (Clean tier).
